# A Bright Rose Cleaning Services

> A Bright Rose Cleaning Services (ABR) is a commercial-only cleaning company based in West Palm Beach, Florida, serving all of Palm Beach County. Founded in 2022 and family-owned (a 62nd Lane, LLC company), ABR provides janitorial service, sanitation, and disinfection for medical and dental offices, daycares, HOA/COA common areas, hospitality venues, and professional offices. ABR does not offer residential cleaning.

Key facts:
- Phone: (561) 202-7885 · Email: Hello@abrightrose.com · Website: https://www.abrightrose.com/
- Service area: West Palm Beach, Palm Beach, Palm Beach Gardens, Jupiter, Wellington, Royal Palm Beach, Lake Worth Beach, Boynton Beach, Delray Beach, Boca Raton, and the rest of Palm Beach County, FL
- Products: Green Seal-certified and EPA Safer Choice products; EPA-registered disinfectants for high-touch areas
- Fully insured; certificate of insurance available on request
- 98% client contract renewal rate
- Every visit follows a documented, site-specific checklist; after-hours scheduling Monday–Saturday
- Free on-site walkthrough and custom quote
